Sundridge Park Golf Club (West Course).name: Sundridge Park Golf Club (West Course)
Sundridge Park Golf Club (West Course).notes: BR1 Bromley (SE London). Shorter and more forgiving than East Course. Lower slopes reported via WHS. Same estate and winter characteristics as East Course.

Surbiton Golf Club.name: Surbiton Golf Club

Surrey Downs Golf Club.notes: KT18 Epsom Downs (SE/SW fringe, classed SE here). Downland/heath terrain on chalk gives strong natural drainage. WHS slopes published (low-to-mid 120s). Wind exposure but generally good winter firmness.

Surrey National Golf Club.name: Surrey National Golf Club
Surrey National Golf Club.notes: RH1 Redhill (SE London fringe). Modern championship layout. High WHS slopes reported (often high-120s to low-130s). Known for year-round playability and strong drainage. Very active online booking.

The Grove Golf Course.name: The Grove Golf Course
The Grove Golf Course.notes: WD3 Watford/Chandler's Cross (NW London fringe). Championship venue with very high green fees. WHS slopes published (high). Modern construction and strong maintenance support good winter playability.

The Hertsmere.name: The Hertsmere
The Hertsmere.notes: WD6 Elstree/Borehamwood (NW London fringe). Public course with open layout. WHS slopes published (mid-120s). Winter playability typical, with softer conditions after heavy rain.

The Leatherhead Club.name: The Leatherhead Club
The Leatherhead Club.notes: KT22 Leatherhead (SW London fringe). Parkland with chalk influence. WHS slopes published (mid-120s). Generally better drainage than inner-London clay courses.

Theydon Bois Golf Course.name: Theydon Bois Golf Course

Walton Heath Golf Club (Old).notes: KT20 Tadworth (SW London fringe). Championship heathland with very high WHS slopes. Sandy base gives outstanding winter playability. Elite, invitation-style access only.

Wentworth Golf Club (Edinburgh Course).name: Wentworth Golf Club (Edinburgh Course)
Wentworth Golf Club (Edinburgh Course).notes: GU25 Virginia Water (SW fringe). Slightly more forgiving than West/East but still elite. WHS slopes published. Strong winter conditioning.

Wentworth Golf Club (West Course).name: Wentworth Golf Club (West Course)
